title: Development and Evaluation Study of Intelligent Cockpit in the Age of Large Models
reasoning: The paper proposes the P-CAFE evaluation framework for Intelligent Cockpit Large Models (ICLM). Within this framework, the 'Knowledge Reasoning' indicator specifically includes the evaluation of the model's ability to respond to 'cultural and ethical matters' (Table 5), making ethics a component of the proposed benchmarking system rather than just a discussion of limitations.
